parsed.rationale: Both `ArtistRepository` and `ReleaseRepository` in the `Metadata` package share three identical members — `cacheKey:(for id: Int) -> String`, `entityKind:String`, and `lastSync:Date?` — differing only in the return type of their `resolve` method (`Artist` vs `Release`). Extracting these three shared members into a common parent protocol `MetadataRepository` eliminates the duplication and makes the structural contract explicit. The `resolve` method can be left in each child protocol (or handled via a PAT associated type), keeping the type-specific return type intact. Both files are production code (all context flags false), so there is no reason to avoid the refactor.
